changelog:
稳定性修复：数据库不再被误锁、实时唤醒判定更准（1.6.4）

数据库：修复升级后打不开、历史与回执写不进去；原库保留，悬挂事务下次打开自动回滚。
实时唤醒：心跳被吞时降级短轮询并每 5 分钟重探，不再每 50 秒断开；门铃健康时显示「实时唤醒已连接」。
后台：进程被杀后接手间隔恢复 60 秒。
投递：服务端响应未写到设备即退回队列，不再等 180 秒（需服务端部署）。
changelogEn:
Stability fixes: database no longer locks itself out, smarter real-time wake-up (1.6.4)

Database: fixed the database failing to open after upgrade; the original file is kept and a dangling transaction rolls back on next open.
Real-time wake-up: when heartbeats are swallowed, degrade to short polling and re-probe every 5 minutes instead of reconnecting every 50 seconds; the receiving card shows "Real-time wake-up connected".
Background: hand-off returns to 60 seconds after the process is killed.
Delivery: the server requeues a response that never reached the device immediately instead of waiting 180 seconds (after server deployment).
